headline: Stallion India Fluorochemicals schedules analyst meet for October 2026
hook: Distant calendar alert for Stallion India
summary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals has scheduled an analyst meet for October 2026, according to a Kalkine India report. why_it_matters: No immediate impact on retail portfolios given the distant date.
